plugins.name: WorkBuddy (Global/Intl)
plugins.description: Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy OAuth provider for CLIProxyAPI, built for Global (Intl) accounts. Daily 30-credit reward via the growth centre on Global accounts, in-plugin 429/code-6004 failover, per-request credit and token log with panel, hidden upstream models, Intl realm routing, CN daily check-in, Global one-shot expert trial, credit lifecycle and a CN/Global credits panel.
